newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London little changed, banks up.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London little changed, banks up.

text.p: Japanese shares trading in London were little changed on Friday although banking stocks and some blue-chips moved ahead on moderate buying interest, dealers said.
"There's been a bit of buying of banking stocks, a little bit of bargain-hunting," one dealer said. "We've also seen some buying of blue-chips although again volume was very small."
Dealers said share prices were generally slightly up on their Tokyo close. The Nikkei 50 index was at 1,353.22 by 1337 GMT, 7.89 points below yesterday's London close.
Overnight, Tokyo stocks closed 54.30 points lower at 18,090.04, after being more than 300 points higher earlier.
Dealers said early momentum evaporated as cautious investors retreated to the sidelines ahead of an important session of parliament on Monday.
